critical_code_review_comments: review_request lists the badge testid as 'guide-godmode-command-center-229' — that looks like an accidental copy of the preview hostname. Actual implementation (correct) uses 'guide-godmode-${clip.slug}' per GuideClipCard.js:119. Not a bug, just a spec-note mismatch.

Admin route is intentionally obfuscated at /wlad-control-x7k9q2 (App.js:163). Fine, but there is no sidebar entry for admins — testing/QA had to grep the route. Consider a hidden admin-only link once is_admin is loaded.

CoursesPage 'Frag Wlad dazu' correctly builds /chat?prefill=<encoded>, but the destination URL was reported as '/chat' with no query — ChatPage consumes and strips the search param immediately; if a user reloads /chat after landing, the prefill is gone. Consider keeping the query until the message is actually sent, or persist in state.

Non-blocking: /video-guide shows 12 poster tiles even though only 6 clips are branded/godmode-passing in the spec (start-1..5 + teaser-login). The extra 6 posters are the older produced clips — content OK, worth confirming the tile count target is 12 (matches implementation) and not 6.
